entries.zh: 口头询问、探询打听；谏，规劝谏诤
entries.en: to inquire by word of mouth, to ask about; to admonish, counsel

entries.zh: 指示、指点；（天主教语境）天主默启、启迪
entries.en: to point, to indicate, to direct; (inspirar) to inspire, breathe into, prompt
entries.notes: 西语 inspirar 原义为吹气、启迪，与汉字“指”仅可经“指点、默启”之义相合，对应依赖推断。

entries.en: to point out, to direct, to instruct; (inspirar) to inspire, prompt divinely
entries.notes: 西语 inspirar 与“指點”经“启导”义相合；官话栏“bey hiam. caute ut Deus:”与词目对应不明。

entries.en: diligent(ly), untiring, persevering; (instar/cuidar) to press earnestly, to take pains

entries.zh: 诚笃、笃实；（做某事）恳切坚持、力行不怠
entries.en: earnest, sincere, devoted; earnest persistence in doing something (instancia)
to be near, to be close at hand; to approach, to arrive at, to be imminent

entries.notes: 汉字栏残损仅存“晉”，西语词头疑为“instar para dar en general a alguno”而音写 cui liu 与之不合，四栏无法互证。
官话栏第二音节污损难辨（T99），义据“知覺”与 instinto 可定为知觉／本能，因证据受损降级。
闽南语音写首音节污损难辨（T99），义据汉字“器”与 instrumento 可定，因证据受损降级。

entries.en: an implement for stirring; (menear) to stir, to move
entries.notes: 汉字栏空缺，释义仅据西语词头“instrumento para menear”（搅动之具）与孤立音写 sāi，无法与汉字互证。

entries.en: sharp, acute; a sharp instrument (R-column gloss: cuchillo, knife)

entries.zh: 农桑器具，农具与蚕桑用具
entries.en: farming and sericulture implements, agricultural tools
implements of war, weapons; instruments, machinery
entries.notes: 闽南语音写第三音节污损难辨（T99），义据“器械”与 instrumento de guerra 可定，因证据受损降级。

entries.en: to ask, to request, to beg (pedir); to implore
to lift, to raise; to bring up, to mention
entries.notes: 与第17条同词头而汉字为“提”，西语词头残讹，释义据“提”与音写 tey 定，词头对应存疑。
